links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting (question-only) with no assigned role
links.outcome: Accuracy, comprehensiveness (5-point Likert) and acceptability of LLM answers to TKA FAQs, rated by four orthopaedic surgeons
links.effect: Role-playing as an experienced orthopaedic surgeon significantly improved all metrics for ChatGPT-3.5 (P < 0.05) and acceptability for ChatGPT-4 (P = 0.033); no significant prompting effects for Gemini or Claude. ChatGPT-4 with role-playing scored accuracy 3.73, comprehensiveness 4.05, acceptability 77.5%; ChatGPT-3.5 with role-playing 3.70, 3.85, 72.5%.
links.quote: Within-model comparisons showed role-playing significantly improved all metrics for ChatGPT-3.5 (P < 0.05) and acceptability for ChatGPT-4 (P = 0.033).
